# Talox

Talox is a local browser runtime for agents built on Playwright. Persistent profiles, structured page state, observability, replay, multi-agent runs, MCP server, plugins, adapters, local vision, iframe trust, presets and practical tools.

## Guide

- Agent guide overview: docs/agent-guide/README.md
- Verified examples: docs/agent-guide/VERIFIED.md
- Capabilities manifest: docs/capabilities.json
- Skill: skills/talox/SKILL.md

Full guide text: see llms-full.txt
